shared_elements: upright pillar/monolith incorporated into a wall
low-relief carving on a vertical shaft
schematic anthropomorphic form suggested by an upright slab
repeated linear/chevron incised markings on the surface
architectural setting with masonry courses framing the carved element
justification: Both surfaces show upright pillar-like slabs set within a wall and bearing shallow schematic relief that reads as anthropomorphic (a broad head-block over a shaft in A, small standing figures beside the pillars in B), which is a moderately specific shared conception of the pillar-as-figure. The clearest difference is that A's decoration is dominated by dense repeated chevron/herringbone bands filling the shaft, whereas B shows discrete small standing figures against a largely plain panel with no comparable patterned infill.
